findings.title: Avoid silently renumbering the existing "recreate" exit code
Ensure Profile is initialized before the feature check runs
Do not append a fixed `--features` option to user-supplied parameters
Do not overwrite existing enabled features in the test CR

false_positives.candidate: RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE changes from 4 to 3, and value 4 is reused for FEATURE_DISABLED, which will break scripts, CI pipelines, automation, operator images, and tests that check for literal exit code 4 expecting 'recreate required'

Profile.isFeatureEnabled() is called before validateConfig(), which may cause NPE if Profile.getInstance() is null, or may check against stale/default feature set ignoring CLI options like --features=rolling-updates
Documentation macro always appends --features=rolling-updates after user parameters, which with last-wins semantics would drop user's other features if they already specified --features
setEnabledFeatures(List.of(ROLLING_UPDATES)) in test replaces any existing enabled features on the default test Keycloak CR instead of merging with them

false_negatives.golden_comment: Incorrect method call for exit codes. The picocli.exit() method calls System.exit() directly, which is problematic:
Need to add changelog/release notes documenting the exit code change and migration guidance
